votes.reason: Core idea is sound and valuable: using the new halted-scan telemetry to measure whether the validated-state gate blocks profitable setups, via cost-adjusted counterfactual logging on DEMO, is legitimate read-side research with trivial rollback. However, the proposal is internally inconsistent about whether halted setups are actually traded: 'proposed_change' describes counterfactual simulation ('had it traded'), while 'falsification_criteria' references 'negative costed expectancy after exploration trades', implying real DEMO orders placed on gate-halted setups. Trading around a protective gate violates the AGENTS.md rule that all orders pass the full strategy/risk/economics gate stack and that no trades be forced merely to demonstrate execution. This ambiguity must be resolved before approval.
